response.justification: While Bogdan has extensive full-stack and systems programming experience, there is minimal evidence of deep JVM, Java/Kotlin, or enterprise framework (Spring, Hibernate, Quarkus) expertise—critical for this role. His work centers on TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web/mobile apps, with only brief mentions of Java in past roles without context of IDE tooling or JVM internals.
strengths: Proven experience building complex developer tooling and open-source projects
Strong background in system-level programming and performance optimization
Demonstrated ability to lead and teach through workshops and community contributions
concerns: No clear evidence of professional Java/Kotlin IDE tooling or JVM internals experience
Lack of demonstrated work with Spring, Hibernate, or enterprise application servers
Primary tech stack is JavaScript/TypeScript and DLang, not JVM ecosystems
